{{Quote|Lord Toda, the time has come for us to bury our age-old rivalry and to unite our planet against invaders like the pirate Kybo Ren.|King Julpa, to Lord Toda|<ref name="TRoKR" />}}
'''Peace negotiations''' took place in [[15 BBY/Legends|15 BBY]] between [[Mon Julpa]], [[King/Legends|king]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tammuz-an/Legends|Tammuz-an]], and [[Malameu Toda]], [[overlord]] of the planet's independent [[Outer Territories]]. While the peace conference made a shaky start, the two leaders were forced to put aside their differences to [[Rescue of Gerin Toda|save]] Toda's daughter, the young [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Gerin Toda|Gerin]], who had been captured for ransom by the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Gir Kybo Ren-Cha]]. Following the rescue mission, Toda and Julpa ended up signing a treaty and uniting Tammuz-an. The king and the princess also became lovers, helping to strengthen ties between the two factions.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|My friends, I have a great project for you. I need help negotiating a peace treaty with Lord Toda.|Mon Julpa, to Jann Tosh and the droids|<ref name="PoT">{{DroidsCite|The Pirates of Tarnoonga}}</ref>}}
[[File:TammuzAn_rivalry.png|thumb|left|200px|An age-old rivalry existed between the Tammuz-an factions.]]
In [[15 BBY/Legends|15 BBY]],<ref name="SON" /> the [[Prince/Legends|crown prince]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tammuz-an/Legends|Tammuz-an]], [[Mon Julpa]], ascended to the position of [[King/Legends|king]] after thwarting an [[Zatec-Cha's coup d'état|attempted coup]] by [[Grand Vizier/Legends|Grand Vizier]] [[Ko Zatec-Cha]]. Despite bearing the title of "King of Tammuz-an," Julpa only reigned over the [[Color/Legends|purple]]-skinned members of [[Tammuz-an (species)/Legends|his species]]. The blue-skinned inhabitants of the planet's [[Outer Territories]] formed a distinct and independent faction, led by [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Malameu Toda]]. The latter was a warrior-[[Chief/Legends|chieftain]]<ref name="TRoKR" /> with a surly and gruff personality,<ref name="AGTSWU2">''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe, Second Edition, Revised and Expanded]]''</ref> and the members of Julpa's faction regarded his tribesmen as barbarians. The two Tammuz-an societies had been rivals since ancient [[Time/Legends|times]], thus preventing their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] from achieving a much needed [[Politics/Legends|political]] unity.<ref name="TRoKR" />

==The negotiations==
{{Quote|Even the slightest upset could completely destroy any hope of negotiating a peace treaty with Tammuz-an's warrior-chieftain Lord Toda.|C-3PO, to R2-D2|<ref name="TRoKR" />}}
[[File:Toda_reluctant.png|thumb|right|230px|Lord Toda was initially reluctant to sign the treaty.]]
During the early [[Standard month/Legends|months]] of his reign, King Julpa opened peace negotiations with Lord Toda, hoping to unite all Tammuz-an against their common enemies, such as the recently arrested and [[Prison/Legends|imprisoned]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] [[Gir Kybo Ren-Cha]]. For an initial meeting in [[Royal castle|his castle]], Julpa requested the help of the [[Human/Legends|Humans]] [[Jann Tosh]] and [[Jessica Meade]], who acted as his [[Advisor/Legends|advisors]], while the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] partners [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] were to perform stewardship duties. Toda, who had come with a few [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] and his [[Youngling/Legends|children]], Princess [[Gerin Toda|Gerin]] and Prince [[Coby]], proved more than reluctant to sign Julpa's charter. The chieftain thought the king had already too many things under control, especially now that Ren-Cha had been put behind bars. That attitude prompted [[Sollag Den]], Julpa's most faithful servant, to verbally spar with Toda in defense of his king. Despite his daughter's attempts to convince him otherwise, Toda left the meeting without signing the treaty. Yet Gerin&mdash;who was infatuated with Julpa&mdash;promised she would make him change his mind by the next [[Standard day/Legends|day]].<ref name="TRoKR" />

However, Ren-Cha managed to escape from the king's jail. He kidnapped Toda's daughter and took her aboard a stolen [[R-22 Spearhead starfighter|R-22 Spearhead]] to the [[Swamp/Legends|swamp]] world of [[Bogden/Legends|Bogden]]. Surprisingly, the pirate offered to release Gerin in exchange for his imprisoned men. As arrangements were made, Meade, Tosh, and the droids were sent to Bogden in secret so they could [[Rescue of Gerin Toda|rescue]] the princess. Simultaneously, the Tammuz-an leaders raided Ren-Cha's [[Unidentified freighter (Bogden)|makeshift prison]] on Bogden with a [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of soldiers, bringing an end to his pirate operation. In the wake of their successful collaboration, Julpa and Toda ended up signing the proposed peace treaty, effectively joining all of Tammuz-an under a single rule.<ref name="TRoKR" /> King Julpa and Princess Gerin also became lovers, further strengthening the new bond between the two factions.<ref name="dbJ">{{DB|character|monjulpa|Julpa, Mon}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The peace negotiations between Mon Julpa and Lord Toda appeared in "[[The Revenge of Kybo Ren]]," the eighth episode in the [[Star Wars: Droids: The Adventures of R2-D2 and C-3PO|''Star Wars: Droids'']] animated television series,<ref name="TRoKR" /> which aired on [[ABC Television Network|ABC]] on [[October 26]], [[1985]].<ref name="TV.com">{{TVcom|url=shows/droids/episodes|text=Droids - Episode Guide}}</ref> However, they were first mentioned in the ending segment of the previous episode, "[[The Pirates of Tarnoonga]],"<ref name="PoT" /> which aired on on [[October 19]] of the same year<ref name="TV.com" /> and announced the plot of the next installment.<ref name="PoT" /> The negotiations were later mentioned in passing in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Databank (original)|Databank]] entries for Mon Julpa,<ref name="dbJ" /> Kybo Ren,<ref name="dbK">{{DB|character|kyboren|Ren-Cha, Gir Kybo}}</ref> and Tammuz-an.<ref name="dbT">{{DB|location|tammuzan|Tammuz-an}}</ref> In [[2013]], Part 2 of ''[[The Droids Re-Animated]]'', a series of reference articles written by [[Abel G. Peña]] and [[Rich Handley]] for the [[Star Wars Blog|''Star Wars'' Blog]], included a summary of the events.<ref name="DRA">{{SW|url=news/the-droids-re-animated-part-2|series=The Droids Re-Animated|text=Part 2|nolive=1}}</ref>
